relationships.subject: CREB
relationships.evidence_quote: Dual-luciferase reporter assays further confirmed that CREB overexpression markedly enhanced Kif1a promoter activity, establishing that CREB directly activates Kif1a transcription (Fig. 6C).

relationships.subject: forskolin
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, FSK markedly upregulated the expression of the KIF1A, CGRP, and c-Fos proteins (Fig. 3D, F).
The NTG-induced upregulation of KIF1A and CGRP was markedly inhibited by i.p. injection of the CREB inhibitor 666 − 15 in male mice (Fig. 4D, F).

relationships.subject: KIF1A
relationships.evidence_quote: co-immunoprecipitation assays demonstrated a physical association between KIF1A and CGRP in SP5C tissue (Fig. 6E)

relationships.subject: KIF1A knockdown
relationships.evidence_quote: Kif1a knockdown not only reduced CGRP expression but also decreased p-CREB and c-Fos levels

relationships.subject: KIF1A overexpression
relationships.evidence_quote: Kif1a overexpression led to significant increases in both KIF1A and CGRP protein levels compared to Control cells (Fig. 8A–D).

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Cotreatment with Olcegepant markedly attenuated the FSK-triggered phosphorylation of CREB and suppressed the upregulation of c-Fos, CGRP, and KIF1A expression (Fig. 9E-H).

relationships.subject: nitroglycerin
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, the protein expression of the c-Fos and CGRP proteins was markedly increased (Fig. 2D, F; Supplementary Fig. 1D, F).

key_findings: CREB directly binds and activates the Kif1a promoter; KIF1A physically associates with CGRP and promotes CGRP synaptic localization.
CGRP receptor blockade with olcegepant abolishes forskolin-induced p-CREB, c-Fos, CGRP and KIF1A, supporting a positive feedback loop driving NTG migraine hypersensitivity.
